requirements.title: Same cognitive Main
requirements.expected: One owner-scoped continuity domain and one immutable admitted snapshot per logical turn serve primary, fallback, retry, schedule, Telegram, and Phase B.

requirements.title: Stable authority and invocation context
requirements.expected: Only declared stable authority can rotate a native binding; time, Feelings, Active Work, reply, schedule, and health state remain per-turn.

requirements.title: Explicit bounded replay and semantic compaction
requirements.expected: ReplayDecisionV1 declares bootstrap or delta, budget, epoch, digest, protected turns, tool pairs, semantic summary, output reserve, and usage scope.

requirements.title: Scheduling is Main later
requirements.expected: Main schedules join the Main continuity domain while new/same visible-thread policy, internal envelope visibility, isolated worker policy, and compact recurrence state stay distinct.

requirements.title: Typed Telegram reply provenance
requirements.expected: ReplyContextV1 is owner/chat scoped, bounded, resolved from durable outbound IDs, and separate from user text; unknown provenance cannot assert denial or spoofing.

requirements.title: Durable scheduled delivery
requirements.expected: All Telegram chunks map to one logical assistant message; schedule sends use idempotent delivery receipts and transport retry never regenerates the AI result.

requirements.title: Governed rapid and parallel turns
requirements.expected: Independent work delegates; rapid corrections coalesce or supersede; unavoidable siblings share a bounded snapshot, TTL, and deterministic accepted-turn commit.

requirements.title: Recall and memory degraded truth
requirements.expected: Recall supplements live continuity and reports healthy empty, unavailable, auth, timeout, stale, source-only, and recovered states without deleting data.

requirements.title: Structured quiet failure truth
requirements.expected: One versioned closed failure contract drives exact retry wording, coalescing, useful-answer precedence, and an approval-gated reversible pause policy; release validation prevents contract drift.

requirements.title: Schedule idempotency and protected live drift
requirements.expected: Exact structural schedule replay creates one schedule; duplicate containment pauses only after reviewed dry run; protected agent drift is reconciled through A/B/C comparison.

requirements.title: Exact-candidate delivery chain
requirements.expected: Requirement, nested source, parent pin, built artifact, installed receipt/process, restart, and exact-candidate QA form one machine-checked trace.

requirements.title: No capability regression
requirements.expected: Continuity fixes preserve Agent Builder authority, native intelligence, tools, connectors, workspaces, refresh/resume, external MCP control, and general worker autonomy.

qaCases.name: Reply why to a scheduled Main output
qaCases.expected: Typed ownership resolves the exact logical assistant output; user text stays only why.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; a natural exact Telegram reply object on repaired pre-liveness source resolved the automated result as Viventium-authored and preserved the reply plus voice; the later final edit was browser-only, but no new Telegram generation was sent after final activation

qaCases.name: Terse reply after reopen
qaCases.expected: A short yes or yeah retains the immediate assistant referent.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; after pre-P0 dirty-source activation and restart, a natural terse Telegram follow-up retained the active recommendation objective; one completed main_context_v1 delta, one accepted Main turn, and no fallback or provider error; final-source browser liveness does not replace a final-source terse Telegram generation

qaCases.name: Rapid revision
qaCases.expected: Corrections are ordered once and one current answer commits.

qaCases.name: Per-turn context does not rotate binding
qaCases.expected: Time, Feelings, Active Work, reply, and health changes do not replace the native Main session.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; resumed Telegram native session plus automated mutation matrix

qaCases.name: Authority change creates epoch
qaCases.expected: A reviewed Agent Builder authority change advances the epoch and rotates only incompatible bindings.

qaCases.name: Bounded new-session bootstrap
qaCases.expected: Bootstrap stays within 50 percent of the provider window and retains current plus three turns.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; exact candidate runtime suite and 100-turn synthetic soak

qaCases.name: Synthetic overlapping-turn A/B/C admission
qaCases.expected: Only accepted deltas are projected; no full duplicate replay occurs.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; pre-final live sequential Telegram delta passed; synthetic overlapping-turn accepted/reserved admission and crash recovery pass automation, but a real simultaneous-turn run and later repaired source are not proved

qaCases.name: Semantic compaction
qaCases.expected: A persisted valid summary preserves pending asks, commitments, corrections, IDs, recurrence outcomes, and tool pairs.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; isolated structured compactor produced a real accepted summary and retained three recent turns; complete semantic field matrix and later repaired source remain unproved

qaCases.name: Overflow compact and retry
qaCases.expected: One compact-and-retry uses the same epoch, digest policy, and capability ceiling; a second overflow fails closed.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; pre-P0 same-epoch compact/retry and second-overflow fail-closed regression passed; forced live overflow and later repaired source remain unrun

qaCases.name: Main new schedule
qaCases.expected: A new visible schedule thread receives bounded Main continuity.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; a pre-final enabled viventium_agent Workbench Run Now used the configured GlassHive/Codex Main, delivered once to LibreChat and Telegram, and its adjacent natural follow-up retained shared Main continuity; exact typed reply-object provenance remains MC-001

qaCases.name: Main same schedule
qaCases.expected: The schedule thread persists and also receives bounded Main continuity.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; one pre-final recurring Main schedule retained one visible conversation across four deliveries and bounded owner continuity

qaCases.name: Isolated GlassHive schedule
qaCases.expected: Isolated work receives only its authorized bounded snapshot and never claims Main identity.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; existing managed memory-off schedule ran on requested/effective Docker lane, imported validated artifact, and survived Workbench reload

qaCases.expected: Every Telegram chunk ID maps to one logical message and any chunk reply resolves it.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; dispatch-to-stream receipt regressions passed, but the live run covered one chunk only

qaCases.name: Usage accounting scope

qaCases.name: Transport failure retry
qaCases.expected: Delivery retries the accepted render once without model regeneration or duplicate bubbles.

qaCases.name: Send and acknowledgement crash windows

qaCases.name: Background delegation and Active Work

qaCases.name: Recall unavailable variants

qaCases.name: Recurring failure wording
qaCases.expected: Visible text states next occurrence only when the failed occurrence will not retry.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; controlled private Telegram failure fixture stated that the occurrence ended and only the next scheduled occurrence remained enabled

qaCases.name: Repeated same-root coalescing
qaCases.expected: One actionable notice represents repeated incidents; reversible pause runs only when approved.

qaCases.name: Exact structural idempotency
qaCases.expected: Exact create/replay yields one schedule while a meaningful changed schedule stays distinct.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; atomic fingerprint regressions preserve meaningful user metadata and exclude scheduler-owned recurrence, failure, misfire, heartbeat, and overlap state

qaCases.name: Protected live drift dry run
qaCases.expected: A/B/C schedule and agent drift is visible before any pause or sync; history is preserved.

qaCases.expected: The parent manifest points to the exact tested nested commits.

qaCases.name: Built and installed artifact identity
qaCases.expected: Built artifacts, installed receipt, and running processes match the tested source candidate.

qaCases.name: Restart, isolation, and privacy
qaCases.expected: Dev/prod remain isolated, state persists after restart, and public artifacts contain no private data.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; supported local restart and public/private scan passed; clean install pending

qaCases.name: Normal chat terminal liveness and persistence
qaCases.expected: A normal answer survives transport loss, resume, completion, refresh, and persisted-state reconciliation without duplicate or vanished text.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; exact final-source isolated headed Chrome recovered an offline backend-completed FINAL without reload, cleared Stop, showed one assistant with no phantom branch or provider error, preserved the Stop-flow partial through refresh, and retained one assistant with no Stop after refresh; exact lost-terminal and 404 remain automated-only because the live recovery replayed FINAL, and provider abort or tombstone remains partial or not run

qaCases.name: Mixed continuity soak
qaCases.expected: At least 100 mixed turns have bounded inputs, correct attribution, no duplicate envelopes, stable bindings, and accepted-turn-only advancement.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; 100-turn synthetic mixed-continuity soak

qaCases.name: Bounded context-header transport
qaCases.expected: The real HTTP parser accepts every application-valid bounded context-header combination while retaining a finite request-head limit.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; pinned 512 KiB h11 buffer and query-aware application guard; real 20 KiB and 300 KiB probes returned HTTP 200, 550 KiB header and query probes returned HTTP 431

qaCases.name: Durable Workbench manual Main receipt
qaCases.expected: Run Now atomically creates one leased pre-dispatch receipt; scheduled and manual authoring exclude each other; active work renews or retains ownership; terminal states clear it; a blocked automatic occurrence is deferred once instead of lost at misfire; stale active states reconcile; Workbench and scheduler share one database resolver.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-20; after supported restart, live configured Main Run Now held a lease, rejected a real scheduled claim, completed silent or nta once, cleared the lease, persisted after browser reload, and emitted no Telegram error or noise; all three synchronous Run Now branches share identity-bound heartbeat code; automated long-overlap deferral, waiting_external retention, lease renewal, terminal clearing, stale recovery, runtime-metadata-safe idempotency, and shared-path cases passed; 188 Workbench plus 101 scheduler or storage tests and 10 subtests passed; full live defer-after-long-overlap remains unrun

qaCases.name: Natural Telegram to browser referent
qaCases.expected: A recent Telegram objective and service referent remain available in a normal browser turn without copying the full transcript or performing an external write.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; pre-final natural read-only Telegram service request, terse follow-up, unsent browser draft, terse browser clarification, refresh, Mongo, and runtime logs

qaCases.name: Physical worker rotation keeps bounded Main continuity
qaCases.expected: A compatible logical Main session can rotate its physical worker, receive bounded accepted bootstrap evidence, and admit only unseen message keys.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; pre-final occupancy-driven Telegram worker rotation retained the terse referent; same logical session and bounded bootstrap completed without re-owning accepted keys

qaCases.name: Same-turn Main re-entry after specialist
qaCases.expected: Main can hand off internally and re-enter in the exact same logical turn without duplicate rejection, stale output reuse, or relaxed conflicts for another turn.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; a pre-final natural Main-to-Reality-Check-to-Main turn completed as three requests under one snapshot and produced one visible Main answer; later interleaved-fragment source is automated-only

qaCases.name: Primary-final single answer and latency
qaCases.expected: A declared primary-final graph exposes one useful Main answer, retains specialist tool evidence internally, persists the same text, and meets the quality-plus-performance metric.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; a pre-final in-process primary-final graph passed live with one Main answer and retained specialist evidence; first connected-service latency remained about 57 seconds and later flat-projection source is automated-only

qaCases.name: Parallel Main comparison survives refresh
qaCases.expected: Two selected Main source components each author one participant-owned visible part, render as two distinct columns, and remain distinct after refresh.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; a pre-final run produced two participant-owned Mongo parts and two browser columns that survived refresh; later interleaved-fragment source is automated-only

qaCases.name: Visible delta ownership survives persistence
qaCases.expected: A StandardGraph ownerless streamed answer is stamped to its sole structural participant; a multi-agent pre-step delta remains explicitly unowned, is never attributed to another participant, and neither visible answer is pruned on refresh.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; repaired-source real-shaped StandardGraph projection or prune, primary-final multi-agent hiding, exact-advance interleaved A/B/A, continuous-text, and split {NTA} cases passed 302 API plus 40 frontend assertions before a later liveness-only edit that did not touch the owning files; final-source stream lifecycle suites also passed; live forced out-of-order interleaving remains unrun

qaCases.name: Structured visible-text projection
qaCases.expected: Multiple visible content parts keep a structural boundary in legacy text, provider history, resumable saves, and recall while ordinary single-part answers stay unchanged.
qaCases.lastRun: 2026-08-21; pre-P0 shared projection, Mongo mirror, request or client history, and recall regressions pass; an explicitly different sanitized text remains authoritative; prior live two-part evidence proved the escaped fused-text shape, but the repaired projection was not written again to the personal corpus
